description: Stitch your videos together in the Switch Editor: puts the given videos on a fresh Editor timeline in the order given and returns the Editor address, where the cut plays in the preview and Export renders it as one video. Use this when the user wants to join, stitch, combine or put clips back to back and keep editing. Pass video ids in play order (from list_my_videos). Spends no tokens; stitch_videos is the one that renders a file straight away.

project_name.description: Optional name for the Editor project.

video_ids.description: Ordered list of your video ids, first to last. At least two.

name: stitch_in_editor
title: Stitch In Editor
